title: Apply semantic projection
purpose: Transform a canonical query result through one explicitly resolved semantic projection authority.
trigger: a canonical query result and projection selector are submitted
desiredOutcome: a contract-valid projected result and canonical projection receipt are produced
constraints: SELECT owns retrieval shape and does not own semantic output shape
projection authority is resolved deterministically with no name-based fallback
row and complete-result scopes use the external semantic kernel
missing values, invalid rows, cardinality, ordering, and additional fields follow declared policy
the capability body contains no decisions, loops, DTO construction, retry, fallback, or failure classification
